verdict.limitations: The assessment of cardiac size is limited by the single frontal and lateral views provided. A more accurate assessment would require additional views or modalities, and patient-specific factors such as body habitus and inspiration level can influence the apparent cardiac size on plain radiographs. The lateral view is not ideal for assessing cardiac size due to magnification and superimposition of structures. The provided images are a single frontal and lateral chest X-ray.
